end.summary:
Ishita practised showing sequence growth with dots in rows and L-shaped pictures.
They identified the next row in a 1, 2, 3 pattern as four dots.
They explained adding one row, one column, and one corner dot: 4 + 4 + 1 = 9.
They extended the same picture method to 12 + 12 + 1 = 25.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised drawing the next step in a growing picture sequence and explaining the added row, column, and corner dot. They used the method 4 + 4 + 1 = 9 and then 12 + 12 + 1 = 25; the corner-dot mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw two or three stages of a square or L-shaped sequence and label each added part.
